exposure: amplitude-integrated electroencephalography (aEEG) parameters (upper boundary voltage, lower boundary voltage, narrow bandwidth, aEEG score)
cranial ultrasound (CUS) parameters (systolic blood flow velocity, diastolic blood flow velocity, resistance index)
cohort: The study included 350 premature infants admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of the First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Medical University between August 2018 and October 2023.
finding: A combined aEEG and CUS model achieved an AUC of 0.89, with a sensitivity of 86.21% and specificity of 79.51%, significantly outperforming models based on aEEG or CUS parameters alone for early detection of BIPI.
